output.summary: The 98% figure is largely an artifact of date revision, not improved service. Revisions per 100 shipments rose 5x after the bonus took effect, at Northgate and Riverside in March and at Pell Junction in July. Reason codes shifted from customer request to operational capacity, and late and unnotified revisions increased. Brightwell's dock log shows 81% on time against the original date, down from 87%, while the scorecard said 98.4%. Dispatchers report pressure to protect the number. RouteWise timing and weather do not fit. The complaint rise is not explained by the portal. The driver shortage is unestablished. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, re-base the incentive, and do not launch the campaign, raise the bonus or fund the hiring plan yet.
